batch099
Snapshot: candidate 9b717d5faaf462f006366b56927cb02e93fb3cc2; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base dfc400f1eecbac81119815aeccfdd0485c715c57. Opening and closing gates exited 0.
Scope: All requested windows returned completely (exit 0): current RU guidance/rubrics; 4 full EN/RU kanji lessons; all 17 EN/RU context pairs; 2 EN-only comparisons; 21 KANJIDIC2 records, header and 2 radical mappings; all 62 JMdict entries and 4 KanjiPedia captures; all 342 current typed rows; proposals, adjudications, clarifications, overlaps and 4 navigation diffs. No unread windows. No public web pages consulted.
C1 CLEAN: New lesson facts/readings/strokes/classical keys agree with frozen source and read official records; examples and cited meanings are supported. Community JLPT labels remain clearly identified as such. Mnemonics are marked as visual aids, not etymology. Optional absent RU word links remain plain text; available lesson links point to existing files.
C2 UNVERIFIED: Four existing-word edits are exactly standalone kanji link wrappers to valid relative targets; no semantic-section or metadata edits are shown, and the wrapper does not disrupt prose. All 12 distractors are supported only as introductory/source-core contrasts; ordinary active-negative quiz safety remains unverified because actual quiz display/options evidence was not in scope. For 暗い, the nav record's pre-edit working-copy raw hash differs from the accepted-base Git-blob raw hash; the shown diff is one wrapper and retains CRLF on that line, but this alone cannot establish whole-file raw parity.
C3 CLEAN: The four lessons use comprehensible Russian, explain required readings/terms in context, distinguish mnemonic from history, and do not require English. Wrappers preserve the surrounding Russian sentences. No confirmed correctable Russian defect found.
N001在→左 S-intro; 在 «существовать; находиться» contrasts with 左 «левый; слева»; stroke resemblance is not semantic overlap. Ordinary quiz safety U.
N002在→右 S-intro; existence/location contrasts with 右 «правый; справа» (including above-mentioned sense); not inferred from N001. Ordinary safety U.
N003在→土 S-intro; existence/location contrasts with 土 «земля; почва»; 土 is a shared component/radical, not proof of meaning overlap. Ordinary safety U.
N004報→持 S-intro; 報 «сообщение; известие» (also reward/retribution) is distinct from 持 «держать; иметь»; alternate 持 reading じ «draw/tie» also does not align. Ordinary safety U.
N005報→場 S-intro; reporting/news contrasts with 場 «место; площадка» and occasion/situation; shared 土 shape is not semantic identity. Ordinary safety U.
N006報→服 S-intro; information/report/reward contrasts with 服 «одежда»; reviewed secondary senses do not equate the titles. Ordinary safety U.
N007増→場 S-intro; increase contrasts with place/site/situation; “increase at a place” does not equate the meanings. Ordinary safety U.
N008増→地 S-intro; increase contrasts with 地 «земля; местность»; the 土 component is only visual. Ordinary safety U.
N009増→暗 S-intro; increase contrasts with 暗 «тёмный»/darkness; shared 日-like shape is only visual. Ordinary safety U.
N010暗→音 S-intro; darkness contrasts with 音 «звук»; 音 is a visible component, not evidence of shared meaning. Ordinary safety U.
N011暗→意 S-intro; dark/gloomy mood contrasts with 意 «смысл; намерение»; mood/mental domains do not establish equivalent answers. Ordinary safety U.
N012暗→映 S-intro; dark/dull colour contrasts with 映 «отражать; показывать изображение»; shared 日-side shape is only visual. Ordinary safety U.
L001在 SUPPORTED: source facts, readings and scoped overlap with 有 are preserved; nonexistent Russian 存在 link is unwrapped.
L002報 SUPPORTED: readings and reporting/reward senses are preserved; nonexistent Russian 報告 link is unwrapped; mnemonic is not history.
L003増 SUPPORTED: all four kun/on readings and intransitive/transitive distinction are preserved; 曽 mnemonic is not etymology.
L004暗 SUPPORTED: readings and 暗記/darkness distinctions are preserved; 日+音 mnemonic makes no origin/phonetic claim.
A001 SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: ある's ordinary kana spelling and 在 senses; does not overstate いる contrast.
A002 SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: 報 information/news and reward/retribution; no unsupported etymology or frequency claim.
A003 SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: 増える/増やす transitivity, alternate 殖 spellings and 減る contrast remain distinct.
A004 SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: 暗い senses and contrasts with 明るい/黒い are appropriately limited.
NAV01 words/増える.md: NAV-ONLY; 増 links to ../kanji/増.md; no prose, metadata or quiz change.
NAV02 words/天気予報.md: NAV-ONLY; 報 links to ../kanji/報.md; no prose or metadata change.
NAV03 words/暗い.md: NAV-ONLY in the shown diff; 暗 links to ../kanji/暗.md; CRLF retained on edited line. Whole-file raw parity remains unverified (see Limits).
NAV04 words/電報.md: NAV-ONLY; 報 links to ../kanji/報.md; no prose or metadata change.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 有/在 existence overlap is inherited and disambiguated by each title's second gloss; neither is a distractor edge. O002 報/告/伝 share an introduced Russian «сообщ-» root but are not direct distractor pairs. O003 増/加/多/重 occupy adjacent increase/add/many/layer domains but are not direct edges. O004 暗/黒/明/夜 are adjacent dark/color/light/time concepts with distinct current labels; no global pair decision follows.
Findings: none confirmed. C2 ordinary quiz safety and NAV03 whole-file raw parity remain unverified, not findings of proven defects.
Optional: none.
Limits: No tests, validators or builds run per instruction. No actual quiz renderer, active option set or runtime negative-selection path was available, so ordinary active-negative safety is not approved for any N001–N012. NAV03 helper hashes compare different raw domains (accepted-base Git blob vs pre-edit working copy); the exact printed line diff is wrapper-only and has CRLF, but the raw-hash discrepancy is unresolved. No external dictionary pages were read.
